trainers.pattern: Search your deck for an Energy card and a Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may switch that card with 1 of your face-down Prize cards. (The cards stay face down.)
trainers.pattern: Look at the top card of your deck. You may switch that card with {N} of your face-down Prize cards. (The cards stay face down.)

trainers.text: Move up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.
trainers.pattern: Move up to {N} damage counters from {N} of your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

trainers.text: All Pokémon that have any Water or Fighting Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) take 20 less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
trainers.pattern: All Pokémon that have any Water or Fighting Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) take {N} less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

trainers.text: Whenever a Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)
trainers.pattern: Whenever a Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

trainers.text: You can use this card only if you have 7 or more cards in the Lost Zone. Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
trainers.pattern: You can use this card only if you have {N} or more cards in the Lost Zone. Search your deck for up to {N} basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: Prevent all damage done to the Pokémon this card is attached to by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have 40 HP or less remaining.
trainers.pattern: Prevent all damage done to the Pokémon this card is attached to by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have {N} HP or less remaining.

trainers.text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck and have your opponent choose 2 of them. Discard the chosen cards and put the remaining cards into your hand.
trainers.pattern: Reveal the top {N} cards of your deck and have your opponent choose {N} of them. Discard the chosen cards and put the remaining cards into your hand.

trainers.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Pokémon Tool cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
trainers.pattern: Look at the top {N} cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Pokémon Tool cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

trainers.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to can attack even if it's Asleep or Paralyzed.
trainers.pattern: The Pokémon this card is attached to can attack even if it's Asleep or Paralyzed.

trainers.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon V, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
trainers.pattern: Search your deck for up to {N} Pokémon V, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead.
trainers.pattern: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw {N} cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw {N} cards instead.

trainers.text: Flip 2 coins. Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of heads, put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
trainers.pattern: Flip {N} coins. Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of heads, put them into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
trainers.pattern: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
trainers.pattern: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)

trainers.text: At the end of each turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to has 30 HP or less remaining and has any damage counters on it, heal 120 damage from it. If you healed any damage in this way, discard this card.
trainers.pattern: At the end of each turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to has {N} HP or less remaining and has any damage counters on it, heal {N} damage from it. If you healed any damage in this way, discard this card.

trainers.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may look at the top card of their deck. They may discard that card.

trainers.text: Put up to 3 Pokémon that have "Hisuian" in their names from your discard pile into your hand.
trainers.pattern: Put up to {N} Pokémon that have "Hisuian" in their names from your discard pile into your hand.

trainers.text:
You may use 4 Quad Stone cards at once.
• If you used 1 card, heal 10 damage from your Active Pokémon.
• If you used 4 cards, heal all damage from each of your Pokémon. (This effect works one time for 4 cards.)
trainers.pattern:

• If you used {N} card, heal {N} damage from your Active Pokémon.
• If you used {N} cards, heal all damage from each of your Pokémon. (This effect works one time for {N} cards.)

trainers.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

trainers.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at the bottom 8 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. If tails, look at the bottom 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

trainers.text: Put up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

trainers.pattern: During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do {N} more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

trainers.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

trainers.text: Put up to 2 Pokémon, each with 90 HP or less, from your discard pile into your hand.

trainers.text: Choose up to 2 of your Fusion Strike Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Fusion Strike Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.
trainers.pattern: Search your deck for up to {N} cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

trainers.text: Choose a Trainer card from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put it into your hand. If yes, put that card into your hand. If no, draw 3 cards.
trainers.pattern: Choose a Trainer card from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put it into your hand. If yes, put that card into your hand. If no, draw {N} cards.
